purpose: HELD same-config replication preparation for KC-S1b. The model, dataset and baseline fragments, frozen DEV-1000 roster, original example-bearing slot-schema fill, request semantics, model geometry and decoding are expected to remain unchanged from SAEA-SLURP-KC-S1B-SLOTS-SCHEMA-DEV1000-V1. This experiment fragment necessarily changes its formal identity and preparation metadata; root must complete the whole-roster request comparison before calling it a same-config replica. It authorizes no contact and carries no scientific verdict.

runtime_version_bridge_requirement: Root must bind the owner-approved runtime-version bridge before any fit or generation contact: the bridge must identify the same pinned llama.cpp build, runtime receipt and per-file model hashes used by the four fragments, and must be registered in the exposure record. This preparation does not invent or copy source hashes.

execution_plan_basis.generation: 1,000 roster contacts plus 8 canaries; proposal 1,050 calls, 3,000 audio seconds and 1 GPU-hour. The registered exposure row supplies the live ceilings. The inherited one-recovery procedure remains in force.
execution_plan_basis.fit: The shared fitter's actual endpoint sequence is 1 GET /props + 1,000 POST /apply-template + 2,000 POST /tokenize = 3,001 tokenizer contacts for the complete roster. The fit exposure proposal must therefore use a 3,001 contact cap (with any additional margin separately approved), not the 1,050 generation cap.

readiness.reason: Preparation only. Root must register both exposure rows, bind the runtime-version bridge, land the full-roster fit artifact and pass the contact-free wire proof before dispatch. The fit uses the inherited failure and one-recovery procedure.

Preparation only. Root must register both exposure rows, bind the runtime-version bridge, land and verify the full-roster fit artifact, and pass the contact-free wire proof before dispatch. The generation cell uses the inherited failure and one-recovery procedure.

prompt_fit.scope: Full frozen DEV-1000 roster, same four fragments and same composed configuration as the generation cell; zero generated tokens.
prompt_fit.artifact_binding: The shared fitter artifact_inputs config digest must bind this composed experiment while stripping only readiness and fit receipt self-reference fields. It must bind the same split identity, runtime receipt, required session identity, implementation hashes and request boundary used by generation.
prompt_fit.dispatch_constraint: Fit and generation are separate cells in this same experiment fragment. The fit cell allows only check, wire-check and prompt-fit; the generation cell allows check, wire-check, prepare-supply, worker and campaign. The generation campaign must hold automatically until the fit artifact is verified.
